entities.summary: Hannes Wader is a German singer-songwriter ("Liedermacher"). He has been an important figure in German leftist circles since the 1970s, with his songs covering such themes as Socialism, Communism, as well as anti-war music. He both wrote new songs and played versions of older historical works.
